question.text: Upon death of the Karta of a HUF, whom can the surviving members appoint as the new Karta?

answer.text: The eldest surviving member, or a coparcener appointed as Karta by agreement among all existing coparceners
Any member chosen by majority vote
Only a male member of the HUF

explanation.text: The Logic: Surviving HUF members may appoint the eldest surviving member as the new Karta, or alternatively a coparcener appointed as Karta by agreement among all existing coparceners. The Trap: Restricting to 'only a male member' or to majority vote ignores the two source-recognised routes — eldest surviving member, or coparcener appointed by agreement of all coparceners. Note: For change of Karta name, the surviving members must submit signed letters and supporting documents to the DP.
